description: Country Cereal Balance Sheets CCBS is published by FAO GIEWS. CCBS maintains cereal supply and utilisation balances by country. Its stated coverage is Global country coverage; annual series from 1980. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Balances combine reported and estimated quantities and should not be read as traced physical shipments. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-fao-giews-country-briefs provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
